execution_frontier.name: Inference-only module rollback diagnosis of protected R2B batch-384 checkpoint
execution_frontier.summary: Protected R2B began from the exact batch-64 state repaired by restoring model_g.dp from the promoted R1 source. The repaired R2B source reproduced 625/625 before training. model_g.flow and model_g.dp remained frozen and hash-stable. R2B remained fully robust at batch 128 and batch 256 (625/625 each), and the primary seed gate remained 125/125 at batches 192 and 320. At global batch 384 the primary gate regressed to 123/125, with DWCACC-0021 ('ei') failing low-level at -57.114 dBFS and DWCACC-0024 ('nei') failing the 0.08 s duration floor at 0.06966 s. Because DP and flow remained bit-stable, further training is blocked while model_g.enc_p and model_g.dec drift from batch 256 to 384 are isolated.

promoted_r1_hybrid.strengthened_gate: 125/125 on each of five deterministic schedules; 625/625 total

protected_r2_abort64.diagnosis: model_g.dp drift was the minimum sufficient cause of the batch-64 robustness regression
protected_r2_abort64.repair: restore model_g.dp from the promoted R1 hybrid and freeze/hash-protect both model_g.dp and model_g.flow

next_safe_execution.purpose: Identify the minimum rollback/protection required to recover 625/625 while retaining as much useful batch-257..384 adaptation as possible.
